answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 47096 Country: MW Title: Leading a Jamaat Prayer Question: Can a handicapped person i.e. who sits on a chair due to physical handicap lead a Jamat Salah? Answer ID: 47096 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1192/776/L=9/1434) A person who performs salah sitting on a chair with gesture may not become imam of those who perform ruku and sajdah normally. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
